# Colophon {.unnumbered}

This book was produced with [Quarto](https://quarto.org),
typeset in [Source Serif 4](https://fonts.adobe.com/fonts/source-serif),
with code blocks set in [JetBrains
Mono](https://www.jetbrains.com/lp/mono/). Source code is
in R 4.4 or later.

The book is hosted at <https://clinical-trials.rgtlab.org>
on Netlify, with continuous deployment via GitHub Actions
from the `rgt47/clinical-trials` repository on every push
to `main`. The deployment recipe is in the series
`HOSTING.md`.

The repository is a zzcollab research compendium of the
`book` archetype: the Quarto book lives under
`analysis/report/`, the R-package skeleton and the
`render-book.yml` workflow come from the archetype, and a
US-spelling gate runs before every render.

The cover is generated procedurally by
`images/build-cover.py` from a watercolor gradient
anchored on `#7a3b52` (the volume's brand oxblood) and
overlaid with Avenir typography. Re-running the script
regenerates the cover; the procedural approach makes the
cover reproducible and editable in version control rather
than dependent on a one-shot AI image-generation step.

Last rendered: see the build timestamp on the homepage.
